Documentation → Releases → 3.4.1

SATOM 3.4.1

A documentation release — the API SATOM exposes to your systems is named and presented as the SATOM API, with its own manual title, its own section on the Features page, its own place in the site navigation and its own category in the Documentation Center, so it can no longer be confused with the Fortinet device APIs SATOM drives internally.

👤 ForOperatorAdministratorAdvanced user
On this page
  • In short
  • Changed
  • Before you upgrade
  • Learn more

Released: 2026-10-21 · All releases

In short#

SATOM has two kinds of API, and the documentation did not tell them apart clearly enough. One is the set of Fortinet device APIs SATOM uses internally to read and write FortiWeb, FortiADC, FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer and FortiAuthenticator. The other is SATOM's own REST API at /api/v1, the one your systems use to talk to SATOM. This release names the second one for what it is — the SATOM API — everywhere it is documented. No code path, schema or behaviour changes.

Changed#

  • The integration manual is the "SATOM API v1 — Integration Manual", and it opens by stating that it is SATOM's own API and not the device API. The base URL is written as https://<your-satom-host>/api/v1, the address of your own SATOM server; the examples used to name three different hosts.
  • The site navigation says "SATOM API" on every page of the manual a node serves at /manual/, and the Features page has a SATOM API section of its own: what a token is, what it can read, what it can act on, what it can author, what no token can ever do, and the OpenAPI document the API serves about itself.
  • Documentation Center: the article is now SATOM API (REST v1) and sits in a top-level category of its own, SATOM API, instead of under Technical. Its address is unchanged, so existing links keep working.

Before you upgrade#

  • Coming from 3.3.2 or older: the same path as for 3.4.0 — apply the 3.3.3 package first, after installing its own update runner.
  • Database changes: none.
  • API tokens: unchanged; the API itself is unchanged.

Learn more#

  • SATOM API (REST v1)
  • Full list of changes: the CHANGELOG in the repository.
